text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Furioso-san, happy birthday☆ Do you think 
you'll be able to use that hair accessory 
I just gave you?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Yes, no problem at all. Allow me to thank 
you once again. —...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
...I must ask you a question. Why did you 
give such a dazzling hair accessory to me?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Furioso-san works so hard for Funabashi, 
she's so sparkling and wonderful that even 
as an Umadol, I look up to her☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I was hoping you could use it to shine 
even brighter!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
To think that was what you truly 
thought...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
*Ahem* For Funabashi's sake, it is only 
natural to put my all into everything.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
If that was the intention, then I shall 
gratefully make full use of it. ...To 
become stronger, and shine brighter.
